S No. and Registrar's  order with  Signatures  WPCRL No. 233 of 2026  Hon'ble Siddhartha Sah, J.
03.02.2026 1.

Mr. Vaibhav Singh Chauhan, learned counsel for the petitioner through V.C.
2.
Mr. G. S. Sandhu, learned Additional A.G., assisted by Mr. Deepak Bharadwaj, Brief Holder for the State.

3. Since allegations of the FIR No. 29 of 2026, dated 30.01.2026, are under Sections 376(2)(n) &
506 of IPC and Section 3 (1) (r) of SC/ST Act, PS Ranipur, District Haridwar and the same would require a notice on the urgency shown by the counsel for the petitioner, the Additional A.G. is requested that the intimation of the case be made to the respondent no. 4 through SSP, Haridwar by tomorrow to enable her to represent herself on 5th February, 2026.
Urgency application no. 1 of 2026 is disposed of accordingly.

(Siddhartha Sah, J.) Vacation Judge 03.02.2026 Kaushal WPCRL/233/2026 on 3 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/44913367/
